title: the_map_that_edits_itself
display_title: My private parkour map keeps changing blocks at 3AM — and I'm the only one with access
beats: My private parkour map keeps changing blocks at 3AM, and I'm the only one with access.
I built this course alone over four months (31F), on a solo server nobody else has the address to.
Last week I logged in to practice and found a single obsidian block added mid-jump, one I never placed.
I deleted it, checked my logs, no other accounts, no backups restored, nothing.
Two nights later a full new section existed past my finish line, a path curving into the dark that I never built.
I ran it anyway, and at the very end, a sign was waiting that just said 'you're getting faster.'
I haven't logged back in since. If you were me, would you?
